name: Slayer Dagger Master
body:
Dagger Masters hone their craft with short blades beyond the skill of all but the most specialized combatants.

Quickdraw (Ex)

At 2nd level, the dagger master gains Quickdraw as a bonus feat.

This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 2nd level.

Dagger Sneak Attack (Ex)

Beginning with 3rd level, a dagger master’s sneak attacks use d8s rather than d6s when using daggers. With all other weapons, a dagger master’s sneak attack uses d4s.

This ability modifies sneak attack.

Stabbing Critical (Ex)

At 4th level, a dagger master can place strikes where they cause the most damage despite their chosen weapon’s small size. Once per round, when a dagger master confirms a critical hit with a dagger they may also treat the critical hit as a sneak attack even if it would not otherwise qualify.

This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 4th level.

Paired Blades (Ex)

At 6th level, the dagger master becomes one with the blades they carry. They gain the Two-Weapon Fighting and Two Weapon Defense feats while wielding two daggers. If the dagger master already possesses the Two-Weapon Fighting feat or Two Weapon Defense feat they may choose a different feat which has Two-Weapon Fighting as a prerequisite for which they qualify.

This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 6th level.

Palm Throw (Ex)

Beginning at 7th level, whenever they make a thrown attack roll with a dagger they may throw two daggers instead. Each dagger must target the same creature and precision damage may only be applied to one of the daggers, though each dagger may critically hit as normal.

This ability replaces stalker.

Greater Paired Blades (Ex)

At 12th level, the dagger master deepens the bond with their signature weapon.

They gain the Improved Two-Weapon Fighting feat and when wielding two daggers each blade uses a d8 for its damage die rather than a d4. This increase in damage die applies to any dagger thrown by the dagger master as well. If the dagger master already possesses the Improved Two-Weapon Fighting feat they may choose a different feat which has Two-Weapon Fighting as a prerequisite for which they qualify.

This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 12th level.

Master of Blades (Su)

At 18th level, all daggers become truly deadly weapons in the hands of the dagger master. The dagger master gains the Greater Two-Weapon Fighting feat without meeting its prerequisites. In addition, whenever the dagger master is wielding two daggers they become +3 weapons, unless the weapon already has a better enhancement bonus and gain the keen and ghost touch weapon qualities.

Thrown daggers maintain these abilities until the end of the dagger master’s turn.

This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 18th level.
